Using the Model Context Protocol, Attio MCP enables compatible AI assistants to securely access and take action on your CRM data once it has been configured and authenticated. This makes it possible to search, create, and update records, work with notes, and manage tasks in Attio using natural language. If you are building AI powered workflows or connecting AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, or other MCP compatible clients to Attio, this is the supported way to do it. What is MCP? Copy link MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It is an open standard that allows AI assistants to securely interact with external tools and data sources. Attio’s MCP implementation provides a structured and permissioned way for AI assistants to access your workspace. Actions are authenticated and respect your existing workspace permissions.
